en.title: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (CVE-2025-59245)
en.summary: An elevation of privilege vulnerability (CVE-2025-59245) affects Microsoft SharePoint Server and Microsoft SharePoint Online with a CVSS score of 9.8.
en.impact: The vulnerability allows for elevation of privilege.
en.fix: The sources list no fixed versions.
checks: Inventory Microsoft SharePoint Server and Microsoft SharePoint Online installations.
Check systems for the Microsoft 2025-Nov security update.

checks: Проведите инвентаризацию установок Microsoft SharePoint Server и Microsoft SharePoint Online.
